articles.title: GTA 6 Dog Poop Gameplay Premieres in the Latest Episode of South Park
articles.summary: GTA 6 made a surprise appearance on South Park with just shy of 20 seconds of genuine, exclusive gameplay that showcased dog poop. The latest episode of Trey Parker and Matt Stone’s hit comedy series, titled Guinea Pig On A Stick, shows a dog doing a poo on a beach (this is South Park after all!).
body: The gameplay is shown during a scene in which the main characters visit a cattle ranche, where a woman hypes up GTA 6 by providing a quick look at the game. “The graphics are seriously next level,” the woman says. “You see the worldbuilding? It’s a dog taking a poop. And people can pick up the dog poop. You can throw things at the person with dog poop, and if they choose to fight back, you can pick up the dog poop and actually attack them with the dog poop. That is what’s coming in November.”
“Wow!” Stan says. “Holy s**t!” Kyle exclaims. “Dude, that game looks f***ing tits!” Cartman offers.

The woman is voiced by Tish Hicks (as confirmed in the credits of the episode). Hicks is a voice actor who narrated the GTA 5 gameplay trailer all those years ago, so fans will probably find her voice familiar.

As for the gameplay, Rockstar had confirmed the dog poop mechanic already, but it’s fun to see it in action. And it’s great to get a sense of the density of NPCs on the beach in gameplay, too, given this sort of scene has been at the heart of official pre-launch videos and screenshots.
points: GTA 6 made a surprise appearance on South Park with just shy of 20 seconds of genuine, exclusive gameplay that showcased dog poop.

articles.title: Fatal Frame Transforms an Ordinary Hobby Into Bone-Chilling Horror
articles.summary: Fatal Frame creator and director Makoto Shibata once said that the most frightening thing is people's imaginations, which are populated by monsters that we can't see. When designing the first installment of one of the 2000s' most iconic horror series, his desire was to create a game that would make…
body: As a kid who grew up with Resident Evil 3 Nemesis and Silent Hill as the epitome of horror games, I became fascinated and terrified by Fatal Frame. Released by Tecmo in 2001 in Japan for the PlayStation 2, the game was created by Shibata and Keisuki Kikuchi, who had worked together before on the Deception series. In Fatal Frame, we play as Miku Hinasaki, a young woman looking for her brother, who has disappeared in the haunted Himoru Mansion. To protect herself, she has only an old camera called Camera Obscura, which is capable of damaging and capturing spirits. While characters and settings change between titles, all games in the series follow a similar structure.

articles.title: Dog poo, anti-social behaviour, and Jason: Our latest look at GTA 6 gameplay comes from an episode of South Park
articles.summary: So we know that GTA 6 has a marketing deal with Sony and the PlayStation 5, and that Rockstar has been engaging with real-world locations to get the word about its latest sandbox game out into the world ahead of its 19th November launch.
body: On Wednesday night (28th October), the latest episode of South Park (which is currently going by the name 'South America', as a jab at President Trump and his insistence on renaming landmarks and locations) aired on Comedy Central, and it included a quick snippet of new gameplay for GTA 6. Eurogamer has seen the episode, and can verify the authenticity of the footage. Rockstar Games is thanked in the credits, too.

As for context for the gameplay footage, it pops up when Cartman, Kyle, Stan, Randy Marsh (with a more youthful appearance, thanks to events earlier in the series), and Butters' father Steven Stoch are sitting around the table as a woman presents the footage to the assembled crew. The setup is that the woman has managed to obtain 'smuggled' footage of Grand Theft Auto 6, the release of which poses and existential threat to the USA as it launches around the Midterm elections. "November is coming," she says. "And everyone's freaking out because we have to choose who will be in charge when we're all dealing with something that we are not prepared for!"

articles.title: More Chinese success as Phantom Blade Zero enjoys a big launch and becomes one of Steam's most played games
articles.summary: Phantom Blade Zero has been officially released, and just as everyone expected, it's popular. The wuxia action game from S-Game debuted to a massive 431,541 concurrent players on Steam (via SteamDB ) at its peak just hours ago.
body: At the time of writing, Phantom Blade Zero is Steam's second most-played game, landing just below Counter-Strike 2, and it's currently leading Steam's global top sellers chart, having jumped 16 places this week. Players appear to be happy with the final game, too, judging by early user reviews on Steam, which currently have it sitting at a Mostly Positive average.

S-Game has yet to announce any sales figures, but the game was estimated to have sold more than 1m copies just before launch. According to Alinea Analytics analyst Rhys Elliott, Phantom Blade Zero sold 850,000 copies across PC and PlayStation 5. It is also available on Tencent WeGame in China, where Elliott estimates it sold enough to bring the total to well above 1m copies.

articles.title: A Famous GTA 4 Meme Is Now a Mechanic in GTA 6
articles.summary: GTA 6 has named one of its biggest mechanics after a beloved GTA 4 meme. In 2008, a Justin.tv channel (now known as Twitch) by the name of FourPlayerPodcast made GTA history. One of the hosts of the channel, Brad Simons, rode a moped around GTA 4's Liberty City.
body: In a new preview from Edge magazine, it was confirmed that players will be able to summon their vehicle using an app called Scooter Brothers. An NPC will deliver your car and then get on a scooter (presumably driven by another "brother") and drive off. Whether or not these so-called scooter brothers will have their own silly lines to honor their origins remains to be seen.

In GTA 5, when switching to Trevor, players would have a chance of seeing the wily character recreating the meme with a frightened NPC. It was a pretty great nod, and now, Rockstar is keeping the tradition alive, though this time with more purpose.

GTA Online has had a mechanic to let you call your car since launch, and Red Dead Redemption also allows you to summon your horse if it's within a reasonable distance. However, this is the first time players will be able to do something like this without cheats in GTA's single-player. It's arguably more necessary than ever, too, as the player's arsenal of weapons and some other important gear is stored in the trunk of their vehicle. It also means your cars likely won't be as disposable as they were in previous games.
points: GTA 6 has named one of its biggest mechanics after a beloved GTA 4 meme.

articles.title: GTA 6's Map Will Open Up Relatively Early and Let You Explore Freely, Developers Are Still Discovering New Parts of the World
articles.summary: GTA 6's world won't be blocked off by story progression, Rockstar confirms. In a new preview from Edge magazine (as relayed by the podcast GTA VI O'Clock ), Rockstar Games confirmed a ton of new details about GTA 6. One of the big bits revealed was that GTA 6's map will open up relatively early.
body: It seems like GTA 6 will be similar, as Edge's story confirms that the state of Leonida will open up relatively early on. Of course, there will likely be some initial story bits to introduce the characters and mechanics before you can go wherever you want. So, if you wish to head north and see the top of the map at the start of the game, you can do so. Of course, the story itself will take you to a lot of places around the map as you experience it, but you won't be chained to Vice City for the first 10 hours if you don't want to be.

Red Dead Redemption 2 also largely lets the player freely explore the map, but there was one area that they couldn't visit until the end of the game: the entire map from the first Red Dead Redemption. While there wasn't as much to see and do there, it was a fun surprise that almost doubled the scope of the game's map. If players tried to go there before the story was ready, they would be shot and killed by snipers.
points: GTA 6's world won't be blocked off by story progression, Rockstar confirms.

articles.title: An Iconic Piece Of Gaming Artwork Just Fetched A Princely Sum At Auction
articles.summary: If you were an arcade operator 45 years ago, your first look at a game that would change the history of the medium came in the form of a humble sales flyer. On the front was a detailed cartoon illustration that envisioned the game's premise: an ape throwing barrels down scaffolding, a terrified…
body: That now-legendary artwork, made to sell the game cabinet to skeptical arcade owners, was among a host of Nintendo memorabilia that went up for auction today -- and it sold for almost $330,000, more than doubling its estimated final bid price.

The Donkey Kong flyer artwork, done by legendary illustrator Leslie Carbaga, is of significant historical importance. It would go on to make numerous appearances across Donkey Kong-related merchandise over the decades and help establish the initial appearance of Mario and DK in early media like the Saturday Supercade cartoon. But, according to former Nintendo advertising director Donna Darbous -- whose collection this piece comes from -- it was originally slated for a dumpster when a storage room was being cleaned out to make office space. Recognizing the value of this and other art being stored, Darbous took it home and stored it away, only uncovering it again recently.

articles.title: GTA 6 Online Could Be Released In Early 2027, Bank Says
articles.summary: Take-Two's biggest release ever, GTA 6, is coming up in November, but the company's share price continues to drop. It's down 21% this year and has now dipped under $200 this week after reaching a 52-week high of $265.
body: In short, the stock is struggling, but one big bank says it sees a lot of upside, in part because Rockstar is expected to release a new version of GTA Online--potentially in the first quarter of 2027--that could generate loads of money.

"We recommend being long $TTWO through the GTA 6 launch," the bank said in a memo to investors seen by Business Insider. Being "long" means the investor would buy and hold. The bank said Take-Two stock "remains cheap."

In particular, Bank of America said investors are not fully appreciating how big GTA Online 2.0 could be. To be sure, Rockstar is calling GTA 6 a single-player game, but everyone expects multiplayer to arrive in some form eventually. GTA Online for GTA 5 has been, and continues to be, a huge moneymaker for Rockstar and Take-Two thanks to its many microtransactions. Many expect a new version of GTA Online for GTA 6 to up the ante even further and give players more reasons to spend time--and money--in the game.

Bank of America said a new version of GTA Online for GTA 6 could launch in the first calendar quarter of 2027, meaning January-March. This is also around the time that a PC edition of GTA 6 could arrive, driving even more revenue.

articles.title: How to complete Four Fierce Axes in Phantom Blade Zero
articles.summary: The Four Fierce Axes quest is likely the second you'll acquire in Phantom Blade Zero, after Flesh Lily, when you find a "Four Axes" case file in the Broken Puppet Valley early on.
body: Thankfully, all of these locations are marked on your map, which makes things easier. "Hang on, that's only six out of seven, though" you may be thinking.

To get the seventh case file, you need to progress to the Village of Lu region after the Crimson Forest. You'll get the Leave None Alive quest, which directs you to head back to the outpost, and upon arriving, you'll find you're now able to get past the barrier to the location of the final case file.
Simply head into the area with the houses, up into the Lady's Cave, follow it through and outside, where you can use the Hunter's Sickles to reach the platform with the last case file.

The final step of this quest is bringing all the evidence to the Child of Insight in Pangzhen, the game's 4th region. You'll have to progress through the Village of Lu area to reach Pangzhen, then a little way into the town itself—thankfully, you'll also have a map marker for this, so it's straightforward enough.

articles.title: LOTRO’s Latest Expansion Is Out Now, Nearly 20 Years After The Game Launched
articles.summary: The Lord of the Rings Online, an MMO based on the popular fantasy series, got its latest expansion today, some 19.5 years after the game was originally released in 2007.
body: The new expansion is called The Wolves of Mordor, and as its name suggests, the expansion is focused on the werewolves of Mordor who are going after the people who took down their master, Sauron.

The expansion takes players beyond Gorgoroth where they will "gather unlikely allies and uncover the secrets hidden in Mordor's forgotten corners." Players will visit three new regions: Heledhris, Parth Rhavas, and Nan Ogol. In those places, players can learn new skills and receive enhancements, and then mix and match them to create a unique playstyle.

The Wolves of Mordor expansion also adds new companions called Neighbors, who have their own unique personality traits and a "dynamic mood system." Players can forge friendships with these companions, and the companions can tell the player stories, provide gifts, and send them on missions.

The Wolves of Mordor is available in a $40 standard edition, an $80 Collector's Edition with extra cosmetics, and the $130 Ultimate Fan Bundle. This version comes with even more cosmetics, additional neighbor characters, and XP boosts, among other things.

articles.title: WoW: Forever Content Updates Will Come Slower Than You Might Expect
articles.summary: Developer Blizzard's new version of its flagship MMORPG, World of Warcraft: Forever, will receive content updates "every four months," avoiding modern WoW's somewhat controversial eight-week patch cycle.
body: In an interview with IGN, Forever principal game designer Kris Zierhut revealed the content schedule plan and explained Blizzard's reasoning. He said WoW Classic's Season of Discovery received updates "way too fast," every 8-10 weeks.

Since the launch of WoW's Dragonflight expansion in 2022, an eight-week update schedule is also what modern WoW operates on. Its more frequent patch schedule means there's always something new to do, but has been criticized by some players due to the buggy nature of recent updates and lackluster content.

On the other hand, some older expansions, like Warlords of Draenor and Shadowlands, saw content droughts that lasted six months or more, leaving players hungry for something new to do. Forever will split the difference.
"We're fairly convinced the correct [update] rate is something closer to once every four months or 17 weeks or three times a year," Zierhut said.
